rationale: PDD has already gapped up 6.55% and run to 77.7% of its intraday range, with price consolidating in a tight band just below the session high ($87.39) on declining 1-minute volume — the easy momentum move has largely played out. Entering long here risks buying near the top of a extended move in a broad market down day (SPY -1.15%, VIXY +7.16%), while entering short against a strong gap-and-hold structure with price above VWAP and 9-EMA offers poor risk/reward given the tight ATR and proximity to the high. The current evidence does not present a clean asymmetric setup in either direction.
